messages:
anya: quick note saw eu-west costs spike when preemptives got reclaimed. per-tenant latency-budget binding amplified penalties. thinking: stop immediate per-route flips; introduce a shared penalty allocator that smooths and redistributes penalties based on capacity + p95 history. sketch below.
kevin: ok but how do we prevent cross-tenant thrash? if allocator moves penalty around too quickly, we may worsen p95 overall
anya: plan: windowed smoothing + capped delta per rebalance. allocator suggests normalized_penalty for each route. tenant explicit floors (tenant.min_penalty) always win. rebalance only allowed at rebalance_min_interval and capped by max_delta_per_rebalance
maria: what about dedicated pools? we cannot shift traffic off dedicated capacity without consent
anya: dedicated pools are read-only to allocator. allocator only controls shared/dynamic pools. for dedicated we emit suggestions and a UI flag; infra makes the final decision
suresh: can we get a small pseudo-config so sim + runtime teams align?
anya: sure: allocator_window=10m; smoothing=ema(0.2); normalize_by=capacity_units,p95; rebalance_min_interval=60s; max_delta_per_rebalance=0.15; tenant_floor=tenant.min_penalty
kevin: ops/alerts: we need clear guardrails before rollout. suggest metrics and alerts for allocator.rebalance_rate, suggested_vs_applied_penalty, and regional_p95_delta
maria: rollout / canary: shadow 2% for 2w, then 25% 1w, 50% 2w, full. rollback if cumulative user_p95 +10% or customer_error_ratio >0.5% sustained 5m. also add manual kill switch in console
deploy-bot: canary created: canary/allocator/4832199999  shadowing ~2% eu-west + us-central
suresh: reproducibility: sim must produce a deterministic replay (replay.tar.gz) containing the input time series and allocator decisions so runtime can replay locally for debugging/CI
anya: will include replay output + small harness runner. also adding telemetry tag allocator_reason with values: capacity_normalization|p95_correction|tenant_floor
kevin: add metric samples to RFC so alerting team can author rules early
anya: will draft RFC with sim results, replay, rollout playbook, alert rules, and example metric streams. thanks all :thumbsup:
